column1: Rank (Overall rank based on Gridiron AI predicted points.)
column7: Practice (The level of participation the player practiced--DNP (did not practice), LP (limited practice), FP (full practice), X (not listed))
column10: Outdoor Weather (Format is "Temperature (F) | Wind Speed (MPH) | Hourly Precipitation (mm/hr)." The forecast game time weather; note that for stadiums with domes this may be irrelevant.)
column11: Stadium Roof (OPEN = no roof | FIXED = immobile roof | RETRACTABLE = roof that can open/close)
column12: Value (How valuable a player is overall taking into account both projected points and how difficult it is to find a replacement player at their position.)
column13: Pos. Rank (Rank sorted by position and based on Gridiron AI predicted points.)
column14: Expected Points (Expected fantasy points based on the selected scoring settings.)
column15: Downside Points (Downside fantasy points based on the selected scoring settings.)
column16: Upside Points (Upside fantasy points based on the selected scoring settings.)
column17: 3-G Points (The average points scored over the last three games excluding games where the player was inactive due to bye week, suspension, or injury.)
column18: 3-G Point Spread (The difference between max and min points in the last 3 weeks ignoring bye weeks, injuries, and suspensions. Requires the player to have been active in at least two of the last three games.)
column19: 3-G Yards (Average sum of passing, rushing, and receiving yards over the past three weeks. Skip BYE weeks, injuries, and suspensions.)
column20: 3-G TDs (Average sum of passing, rushing, and receiving touchdowns over the past three weeks. Skip BYE weeks, injuries, and suspensions.)
column21: 3-G Turnovers (Average sum of fumbles and interceptions over the past three weeks. Skip BYE weeks, injuries, and suspensions.)
column22: LG Touches (Sum of passing attempts, rushing attempts, and targets last week.)
column23: 3-G Touches (Average sum of passing attempts, rushing attempts, and targets over the past three weeks. Skip BYE weeks, injuries, and suspensions.)
column24: LG Snap % (Percent of snaps the player was on the field last week.)
column25: 3-G Snap % (Average percent of snaps the player was on the field over the past three weeks. Skip BYE weeks, injuries, and suspensions.)
column26: LG Touch % (Percent of snaps last week the player accrued a touch when they were on the field for the play.)
column27: 3-G Touch % (Average percent of snaps over the past three weeks the player accrued a touch when they were on the field for the play. Skip BYE weeks, injuries, and suspensions.)
column28: Gridiron ID (The Gridiron AI player ID)
